integrity: Exact symbolic polynomial identity plus analytic probabilistic derivation; proof does not rely on finite parameter sampling. No independent audit or priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Exactly three independent proportional-hazards lifetimes with a shared continuous strictly increasing cumulative hazard; all hazard multipliers strictly positive.
Optimality approached at a boundary with one vanishing hazard; it is not an interior equality case.
No finite-sample estimation, more components, nonproportional hazards, censoring or dependence are covered.
title: Sharp quadratic Kendall concordance stability for three proportional-hazards failures
